metadata.title: Create Guideline File
metadata.purposeAndUsage: Write a guideline markdown file that answers a 'How to' question with practical steps and examples. Use when creating a new guideline document as part of the create-guideline template.

output.description: Complete guideline markdown file with practical steps and examples

prerequisites: Context already gathered (guideline name, category, purpose)
Understanding of what 'How to' question this answers
specificActions: Follow the substeps below in sequence
Workflow: review context → research examples → structure content → write file → verify quality
Use Q&A Session component when context is incomplete or clarification is needed
Use real code examples from the project when possible
Match style of existing guidelines in the same category
tools: read_file - Read memory and existing guidelines
codebase_search - Find relevant examples from codebase
bestPractices: Use real code examples from the project when possible
Link to related guidelines if relevant

substeps.name: Review Context
substeps.description: Review the context and parameters gathered in the previous step
actions: Read memory.json for guideline parameters (name, category, purpose)
Confirm the guideline file path: .user-processes/guidelines/{category}/how-to-{name}.md
Review any sources or patterns identified
If context incomplete: Use Q&A Session component to gather missing information from user

substeps.name: Research Examples
substeps.description: Find relevant examples from the codebase to include in the guideline
actions: Search codebase for examples related to the guideline topic
Review existing guidelines in the same category for style consistency
Identify code patterns, conventions, or templates to reference
Note common pitfalls or edge cases to warn about
If clarification needed: Use Q&A Session to ask user about preferred examples, level of detail, or project-specific conventions

substeps.name: Structure Content
actions: Draft the main sections: title, numbered steps, examples, optional tips
Determine level of detail needed
Plan which examples to include

substeps.name: Write Guideline File
substeps.description: Create the actual guideline markdown file
actions: Create the file at .user-processes/guidelines/{category}/how-to-{name}.md
Write clear, actionable content
Include practical examples (code snippets, configurations)
Keep content concise but comprehensive
Use consistent formatting and style

substeps.name: Verify Quality
substeps.description: Review the guideline for quality and completeness
actions: Verify the title matches the 'How to' question
Check that steps are clear and actionable
Ensure examples are correct and relevant
Verify formatting is consistent with other guidelines
Confirm file is in correct location

flow.description: Linear flow with Q&A decision points: Review Context (→ Q&A if incomplete) → Research Examples (→ Q&A if clarification needed) → Structure Content → Write File → Verify Quality (→ Revise if needed)
